what: Two v2 gaps the docs name are closed (queue 01064, 01002): (1) every cargo command, and the new `blaze toolchain`, downloads blaze's own Rust once into ~/.blaze (BLAZE_HOME) unless rustup has it (crates/blaze-cargo/src/toolchain.rs ensure); install.sh:305's `blaze toolchain` works again and --no-toolchain's 'the first build downloads it' is true. (2) a unit whose package's rust-version is newer than blaze's Rust is refused as cargo refuses it ("rustc X is not supported by the following package..."), unless --ignore-rust-version (crates/blaze-units/src/load/units.rs); under -v a rust-toolchain file above the cwd is said to be ignored. docs/toolchain.md and docs/install.md:68 should drop those gaps.
